verdict: The promise contract closed end to end on a real model for the first time. Sentence 1: Varo promised the copy within the hour; the fill carried consequences.promise with due 1h and a trace; the same root folded PromiseMade -> NpcPlanFormed (due 3900000000) -> ActivityStarted. Sentence 2: the 61-minute wait crossed the due point; due-first settlement asked the actor-plan transport (execute), NpcActionCommitted, CanonicalFactDeclared for the trace, both activities completed, and the narration showed the copy on the desk before the wait ended. Sentence 3 was never sent: the batch runner hardcodes a per-HTTP limit of 5 while the plan says 7, and the wait spent exactly 7, so the runner stopped the batch on its own rule. Also the first real unparsed re-emit: call 2's JSON had an unescaped inner quote and call 3 restated the same ruling. Response-basis plain enum: six refs, all inside it.
